title: Luminous Painterly
description: Un style d'illustration numérique contemporain caractérisé par des coups de pinceau texturés et un éclairage atmosphérique radieux. Les formes sont définies par des blocs de couleurs lumineuses sans contours, utilisant de forts contrastes de température.
description_en: A contemporary digital illustration style characterized by blocky, textured brushstrokes and glowing atmospheric lighting. Forms are defined by luminous color blocking rather than line work, utilizing strong temperature contrasts between warm focal glows and cool shadows.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration numérique contemporain caractérisé par des coups de pinceau texturés et un éclairage atmosphérique radieux. Les formes sont définies par des blocs de couleurs lumineuses sans contours, utilisant de forts contrastes de température.
prompt: Digital impressionist illustration, characterized by thick, blocky brushstrokes and opaque layering. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Execute the rendering without harsh outlines or line work; define all forms entirely through vibrant color blocking and value contrast. Lighting is central to the style, featuring strong, glowing focal illumination that radiates soft, diffused light outward. Utilize {{primary_color}} for the dominant atmospheric washes, {{accent_color}} for the intense, luminescent light sources, and {{secondary_color}} for the deep, textured shadows. Establish a strong color temperature contrast, pushing warm light against cool ambient shadows. The texture mimics a digital canvas with rough, flat brush marks and a slightly chalky, matte finish. Edges of subjects should be ragged, painterly, and overlapping, blending softly into the atmospheric depth. The mood is serene, magical, and cozy, reminiscent of high-end visual development art for animated films. video.motion: Gentle, subtle undulation of light sources creating a pulsating, magical glow. Soft, flowing movement of atmospheric elements like mist or floating particles.
video.camera: Slow, steady push-in or subtle parallax drift to enhance the atmospheric depth and layers.
video.temporal_texture: Brushstrokes and painterly textures must remain locked to the surfaces of objects, avoiding boiling or flickering edges.
video.avoid: Avoid fast, jerky movements, high frame rate photorealism, sharp vector-like scaling, or anything that breaks the painted illusion.
